name: edf2csv
description: Convert EDF, EDF+ and BDF biosignal recordings (European Data Format) to CSV from the command line. Local, streaming, and never resamples or alters units.
author: Sarthak Tayal

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run fixtures && node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm test
scripts.crossvalidate: npm run build && node test/crossvalidate/generate.mjs && python3 test/crossvalidate/compare.py
scripts.fuzz: npm run build && npm run fixtures && node test/fuzz/mutate.mjs
scripts.fuzz:batch: npm run build && npm run fixtures && node test/fuzz/trees.mjs
scripts.estimate: npm run build && npm run fixtures && node test/fuzz/estimate.mjs
scripts.layouts: npm run build && npm run fixtures && node test/fuzz/layouts.mjs
